steps.content: Then, your eyes snap open. A withered field stretches to the horizon. Broken rice straw shudders in the wind, like the forgotten corpses of a dead age.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Is this place... also part of Hilda's consciousness?
You take a few cautious steps. The ground is indeed solid, not that consuming mud of pure Mania.

But the field ahead is a barren wasteland, locked in a deathly silence. The soil is a grim amalgam of pitch-black gravel and pale ash, like a grave for countless souls, all of it glistening with an ominous dark light. This is a dead land, incapable of sustaining any life.
A deep sense of foreboding tightens your chest. As your eyes sweep the horizon, a thunderous roar tears through the wind—

steps.speaker: Shane
steps.content: Open your eyes! Look! This is the land your metropoles swore to protect with their Hypercubes! Look at it! Where are they?! Where's our protection now?!

On a nearby clearing, a grotesque assembly of spectral figures has gathered. Their forms are twisted, their clothes little more than tatters, and their faces shattered. Yet from the fractures, their eyes burn with a unified, hellish red, one of hatred and rage. In their clutches are contaminated, makeshift weapons, all thrust menacingly toward the captive huddled at their center.
Beneath the skeletal branches of a pitch-black dead tree, a single figure kneels. A crudely sharpened branch has pierced through her shoulder blade, pinning her in a macabre crucifixion.
Her blood traces a slow, dark path down the dead wood, feeding the parched and cracked earth beneath.

And then, Shane's voice erupts. He seems to merge with the horde, a single consciousness shouting with the force of a legion. His words land not as speech, but as a thunderclap that shakes the very air.

steps.speaker: Shane
steps.content: This is the true face of your metropoles! You've sucked us dry, left us with nothing! Now you'll get the same mercy you showed us!
At this moment, someone notices your presence.

steps.speaker: Villager A
steps.content: ...Who are you? Are you another lapdog of the metropoles?
Before you can answer, another voice speaks up.

steps.speaker: Shane
steps.content: Wait... this one's different from the metropole scum... I know that scent... DisCity! You're from DisCity!
A sea of eyes locks onto you, their collective gaze a physical pressure. It's a volatile mix of naked suspicion, sharp scrutiny, and beneath it all... a disquieting flicker of expectation.

steps.speaker: Shane
steps.content: Then you must hate them as much as we do. You had the guts to stand up to all the metropoles. You know the blood on their hands better than anyone!
With a sweeping gesture, he points at Hilda.

steps.speaker: Shane
steps.content: She's one of them! She stands with the bloodsuckers, and in her veins flows the life they stole from our land! The sweat and blood of your people and mine!

steps.speaker: Shane
steps.content: Now, she pays her debt!
A hunched shadow trembles in the gloom, offering you a short hoe caked in bloody mud.

steps.speaker: Villager B
steps.content: You hate them too, don't you? Here! Take it! Make her feel our suffering! Avenge us! Avenge yourself!

steps.speaker: Crowd
steps.content:
Yeah! Revenge! Revenge!
That's right! Revenge!
We have to have revenge!

steps.speaker: Crowd
steps.content:
You're with us! We're the same!
Yes! The same!

steps.speaker: Crowd
steps.content: Make her atone! Make her pay!

More and more eyes are now turning toward you. The crowd's initial hostility has melted away, replaced by a frenzied, expectant acceptance. More crude weapons are thrust into your line of sight, their rough surfaces gleaming in the dim light.
More crude weapons are thrust into your line of sight, awaiting your choice. You remain still, your eyes drifting over the proffered tools before finally coming to rest on Hilda's pallid face.

She feels the weight of your gaze. Her previously unfocused eyes struggle to find yours, holding their concentration for a single, lucid moment. In them, you see no fear, only a profound and weary guilt—and beneath it, a calm that borders on relief.
It is a silent plea, as clear as if she had spoken aloud: This is what I deserve. Please, go ahead.

steps.speaker: Shane
steps.content: What are you waiting for?! Don't tell me you don't hate her! Hate her! Hate her like we do! Let it out!
Every voice, every gaze, crushes down upon you.
The coppery stench of blood, the venom of their accusations, the shadows contorting into demons... it all converges, forcing a choice. Do you join this tide of hatred, or...
